## Quick comparison

| Tool | Ease of use | Client management | Time tracking | Best fit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ClickUp | Moderate | Good | Yes | All-round agency work |
| Teamwork | Moderate | Excellent | Yes | Client billing and retainers |
| monday.com | Easy | Good | Plan-dependent | Creative workflows |
| Asana | Easy | Good for task visibility | Integration often needed | Structured delivery |
| Basecamp | Very easy | Good | No native tracking | Simple collaboration |

Feature and pricing comparisons are based on 2026 agency software reviews; confirm current plan limits before subscribing. <Cite refs={["turn400502search3","turn400502search4","turn400502search9"]}/>

## Which one should you choose?

- **Small web development agency:** ClickUp.
- **Agency billing clients for hours or retainers:** Teamwork.
- **Design, branding, or marketing agency:** monday.com.
- **Agency with repeatable processes and deadlines:** Asana.
- **Small team that hates complicated software:** Basecamp.

My recommendation is to start by trialling **ClickUp and Teamwork**. ClickUp is the more flexible general-purpose option, while Teamwork is more focused on the business of delivering and billing client work.
